_readme: Magnet programs per school, taken from the M-DCPS Magnet Program Catalog 2027-2028 (English PDF, school listing on pages 16-22; LOC# in the catalog equals the county school ID). Themes are the program names as the catalog words them, with its footnote markers removed (* auditions required, ** language proficiency required, *** Key Biscayne residency priority, double-dagger enhanced criteria): families must check the catalog for those requirements. Extracted automatically and spot-checked; a person should review before real families rely on it. Fields: source_id (county school ID); themes; verified_by; verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD); catalog_url.
